headline: Committee to discuss library programming, Annual Meeting, Corporators, Annual Appeal, and a November Lyceum Event.
summary: The committee will review a library programming update and discuss a tech event, the Annual Meeting, Corporators, the Annual Appeal, and the November Lyceum Event, along with a Development Committee update.
